title: Understanding Bulk Modulus
text: The bulk modulus $$K$$ is a measure of a material's resistance to uniform compression. It is defined as the ratio of the applied pressure increase to the relative decrease in volume.

title: Formula for Fractional Volume Change
text: The fractional change in volume ($$\Delta$$V/V) can be calculated using the formula: $$\Delta$$V/V=-$$\Delta$$P/K, $$where$$ $$\Delta\$\$P$$ $$is$$ $$the$$ $$change$$ $$in$$ $$pressure$$ $$and$$ $$K$$ $$is$$ $$the$$ $$bulk$$ $$modulus$$.

title: Calculate the Fractional Volume Change
text: Given that the bulk modulus K=$$1.0\times10**{11}$$ N/m² and the pressure change $$\Delta$$P=$$10**{7}$$ N/m², use the formula $$\Delta$$V/V=-$$\Delta$$P/K $$to$$ $$find$$ $$the$$ $$fractional$$ $$volume$$ $$change$$.
